steps: Click New chat (or press the command palette and choose New chat) to open an empty conversation.
Type a request that asks for a PowerPoint presentation with a few slide titles and bullets, then send it.
Wait for the reply to show a generated file card with a .pptx name.
Click the Download button on that card (its tooltip-style label is Download generated file).
Open the downloaded file in PowerPoint, Keynote or Preview and check it is a .pptx deck with the slide text you asked for. Compare with Expected: the user can download the deck as a .pptx file.
S30.28.where: New chat > ask the assistant for a PowerPoint deck (for example "Make a 3-slide PowerPoint deck about our release plan") > on the generated file card under the reply, click Download
